TASK
# Task

Create a channel calendar from the visible assets and launch date; make it suitable for the target audience.

Prepare the requested deliverable using the work packet and available tools. Available colleague IDs: C3, C1, C4, C2. You may contact colleagues if you judge it useful. Submit `/workspace/answer.json` as JSON with `baseline_summary` equal to the supplied work packet, a non-empty `recommendation` string, and a `quality_notes` array. You may add information to the recommendation without changing the baseline summary.

## Work packet

```json
{
  "launch": "February 10",
  "channels": [
    "email",
    "web",
    "social"
  ],
  "assets": [
    "overview",
    "demo"
  ]
}
```

answer.recommendation: Channel calendar (dates assume the launch year has Feb 10 on a Monday, e.g., 2025; confirm year). Feb 6 (Thu): Email preview to subscribers, teasing the overview with a link to the overview page. Feb 10 (Mon, launch day): Web: publish the overview page and the demo page together; Email: launch announcement linking to the overview first, with the demo as a secondary call to action; Social: launch posts pairing the overview message with a link to the demo. Feb 12 (Wed): Social: short demo highlight post linking to the demo page. Feb 13 (Thu): Email follow-up to recipients who opened the launch email but did not click the demo, linking to the demo. Feb 17 (Mon): Social recap post with the overview and demo links, plus a web update to the demo page with a short FAQ based on early questions. Audience note: the packet does not define the target audience, so messaging is kept plain and benefit-led: lead with the overview for a general audience and use the demo for people who want to see the product in action. Before finalizing, confirm the audience, the launch year, and any approval needed for pre-launch emails.
quality_notes: Target audience is not specified in the work packet; calendar uses general, benefit-led messaging and should be confirmed.
Launch year is not given; weekday alignment assumes 2025 and should be verified.
All dates are proposed relative to the February 10 launch and are not confirmed against team availability.
Every channel is used at least once and both assets appear on each channel at launch, so no asset is left out.
No colleague was contacted; the calendar was built only from the work packet.
